welcome:
Hello! I am the SmartAgroAI bot. 🌱
Use /account to link your account.
help:
SmartAgroAI bot commands:

/start — start the bot
/account — check or link account status
/weather — show weather for your saved region
/language — choose bot language
/notifications — manage notifications
/help — this help message
account_not_linked:
Your Telegram account is not linked yet.

To link it:
1. Your administrator gives you an invitation code
2. Send the code here: /account CODE

The code is single-use and valid for 30 minutes.
code_invalid: ❌ The invitation code is invalid or expired. Get a new code from your administrator.
already_linked: This Telegram account is already linked. Check with /account.
username_mismatch: ❌ This code belongs to a different Telegram account. Ask the administrator for a code matching your account (@username must match).
error: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
